summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Football PWA for tablets. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). Frontend UI functional with minor overlay issues from Emergent badge affecting some click interactions.

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent badge overlay blocks some click interactions
ui_bugs.workaround: Force clicks work around the issue

design_issues.issue: Some content areas show as empty/loading skeleton on Primeira Liga page

League navigation pills work correctly
League detail page loads with tabs (Table, Matches, Top Scorers)
Standings table displays team data correctly
Bottom navigation works for all sections
User authentication (login/logout) works perfectly
Favorites page loads for authenticated users
Match cards display correctly with team crests and scores

Responsive design appropriate for 11-inch tablet
